verdict.rationale: Scheduled or background automation (e.g., recurring runs or drift detection) is a fair axis for an infrastructure-as-code tool, but the evidence shows no first-party capability for it. The CLI commands, OCI image, saved plan files and JSON output are building blocks a user could wire into an external CI or scheduler. Those are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds, not an autonomous background automation feature of OpenTofu itself.
